The mechanical watch movements of the 1960s and 1970s represent the culmination of hundreds of years of technological development. With the advent of quartz watches in the late 1970s this technology became obsolete. The great thing about a watch that works with obsolete technology is: you don't have to worry about it becoming obsolete! What is a 5 year-old smartphone worth today? Nothing.
